subject: Bespoke erase/retention playbook - Orchid Health coordination
messages:
From: Caroline M. <caroline@orchidhealth.com>

Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Bespoke retention/erase windows Q&A for EU pilot

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the demo last week — excited about the performance numbers. We need to align on a couple of specific commitments for our EU pilot followed by a broader roll-out. TL;DR: we need a clear SLA/order form clause for bespoke retention windows and guaranteed deletion timelines. Can you confirm what Redwood can commit to for the following?

- EU production PII: stay within EU (geolocked) and primary data residency for 90 days for ephemeral sessions.
- US region logs/telemetry: 30-day persistent retention for analytics (we can provide a separate consent).
- Deletion guarantee on contract termination: we require a certified deletion window of <=72 hours for primary data and evidence of deletion (kinds of artifacts preferred: deletion run report + sha256 manifest).

Also need to understand how backups/snapshots and system-level logs are handled (are those on the same timeline or different?). I'm attaching a simple data map for our flows.

Can you route this to the right person on your side and share proposed SLA language we can put in an order form?

Thanks,
Caroline
Director, Infrastructure & Security
Orchid Health

Caroline — thanks for the clear asks and the data map. Looping in Aditya (infra/serving runtime) and Neha (compliance/legal) to confirm. Quick initial notes:

- Residency: we can geolock primary data to EU regions and set segregation in the order form.
- Ephemeral retention: a 90-day ephemeral residency window for session data is doable as an order form field. We need to clarify which objects you consider "ephemeral sessions" vs. "customer-managed artifacts" (e.g., exported embeddings).
- Deletion within 72 hours for primary data: technically possible for active data, but backup/snapshot retention and low-level logs may need a separate clause — will advise.

Aditya/Neha, can you confirm the expected deletion path and a recommended order form clause we can present to Orchid? Also whether we can provide a signed deletion certificate (manifest + run report) that includes hashes.

I will prepare a redline SLA draft once we have tech/legal confirmation.

—Kimberly

Subject: Re: Bespoke retention/erase windows Q&A for EU pilot

Hey team — technical run-through below (keeping Caroline on loop so Orchid sees constraints/controls).

1) Primary data (live objects, customer buckets):
   - We can geolock and set an order-form field for a 90-day ephemeral residency window. Deletion is transactional for primary objects and can be completed within 72 hours of a request or contract termination. We will run an automated deletion job that removes all live objects and logs the operations.

2) Backups/snapshots:
   - For resiliency we take incremental snapshots; by default snapshots are retained for up to 14 days depending on configured SLAs. We can offer an accelerated snapshot purge addendum: with a paid add-on we can run expedited snapshot deletion and verification, reducing snapshot residuals to within 7 days.

3) Logs and telemetry:
   - Application-level telemetry and usage logs are stored in the region you select for analytics. We can set a 30-day retention for analytics logs as requested, but note some operational logs (control-plane audit trails required for security) are retained for 90 days by default and require an explicit order-form exemption to reduce.

4) For evidence of deletion:
   - We can provide a deletion run report (timestamped job output) and a manifest of deleted object identifiers. For extra assurance we can include SHA256 hashes for primary objects that Orchid provides at onboarding (customer supplies manifest of object ids+hashes).

5) Recommended order-form language (high level):
   - "Redwood will geolock and maintain customer primary data in the EU region for 90 days for designated ephemeral objects. Upon contract termination Redwood will execute deletion of primary objects within 72 hours and provide a deletion manifest and run report. Backups and snapshots are retained for N days unless accelerated-purge addendum is executed (see Schedule A)."

6) Implementation caveats:
   - We cannot retroactively remove data embedded in external caches or third-party logs beyond our control. Also note that certified deletion of data from cold archives (tape/third-party long-term store) may require different lead times and separate contractual commitments.

Neha — please add any legal/compliance language we should include for the attestation and evidence format.

-Aditya
Staff Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Bespoke retention/erase windows Q&A for EU pilot

Caroline — thanks for patience. Attached is a first-pass redline of SLA language (redline_sla_draft_v1.docx) that combines Aditya's technical constraints with our legal wording. Summary of what we can commit in the order form: 

- Residency: Primary customer data geolocked to EU region (per order form).
- Retention: Ephemeral session objects: 90 days (configurable field). Analytics logs (US region): 30 days. Operational/control-plane logs: 90 days by default, with an option to reduce to 30 days via signed exception.
- Deletion on termination: Certified deletion of primary objects within 72 hours. Evidence package includes deletion run report (timestamped), deletion manifest with object IDs, and optional SHA256 hashes for objects provided by the customer at onboarding.
- Backups/snapshots: Standard retention up to 14 days; accelerated-purge addendum available to reduce to a 7-day window. This will be surfaced as Schedule A in the order form and requires an additional fee.
- Exclusions: Long-term cold archives, third-party-managed replicas, and data outside Redwood's control are excluded and will be addressed in a separate Escrow/Handback addendum.

Next steps: 1) Caroline — please review the attached redline and flag anything you cannot accept. 2) If acceptable, we'll prepare a DocuSign with the Order Form and Schedule A (accelerated purge). Link below when ready.

DocuSign link (placeholder): https://docusign.net/sign/abc123

Happy to jump on a 30-minute call to walk through the clauses if that helps.

Thanks,
—Kimberly
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
